pages.title: Hello Kitty Waves in a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hello Kitty waving in a pom-pom Santa hat, with fluffy trim on her coat and three outlined snowflakes around her.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Decorates a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty hangs a round ornament on a star-topped Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, with a scarf around her neck and a gift below.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Dresses Up as Santa Claus Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty dresses as Santa Claus in a belted coat and boots beside a sack with a teddy bear and gifts.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Holds a Striped Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hello Kitty holding a tall striped candy cane, with a fringed scarf and three snowflakes to color around her.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Peeks Out of a Christmas Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty peeks over the cuff of a Christmas stocking in this printable coloring page, with holly berries, a striped toe, and stars on the stocking.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Wraps Christmas Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty pulls ribbon across a Christmas present at a round table with a ribbon spool and two patterned gifts.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Opens a Christmas Present Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty lifts the lid of a Christmas present to find a teddy bear on this printable coloring page, with stockings and tree ornaments behind her.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Builds a Snowman for Christmas Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty gives a snowman its carrot nose, with a striped scarf and a floppy Santa hat on the snowman.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Decorates a Gingerbread House Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty pipes icing onto a gingerbread roof in this printable coloring page, with peppermint windows, candy cane pillars, and a row of gumdrops.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Bakes Christmas Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hello Kitty pressing a star cutter into Christmas cookie dough, with a rolling pin and a tray of tree-shaped cookies nearby.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Hangs a Christmas Wreath Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty hangs a Christmas wreath on a paneled door, with holly leaves and a large bow around the wreath.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Rides in Santa's Sleigh Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty rides in Santa's sleigh in this printable coloring page, with curled runners below her and a stack of wrapped gifts behind her.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Wears Reindeer Antlers Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hello Kitty wearing reindeer antlers on a headband, with a star on her fringed scarf and more stars around her.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Feeds a Christmas Reindeer Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty feeds a carrot to a Christmas reindeer, with branching antlers and a bell hanging below its ruffled collar.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Meets Santa Claus in the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty reaches toward Santa Claus in this printable coloring page as he holds out a ribbon-tied present beside a snowy evergreen tree.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Holds a Merry Christmas Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: Wearing a Santa hat, Hello Kitty holds a Merry Christmas sign in this printable coloring page, with large outlined letters, holly, and falling snowflakes.

pages.title: Hello Kitty and Friends Sing Christmas Carols Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty, My Melody, and Cinnamoroll sing Christmas carols in this printable coloring page, holding open songbooks beneath floating music notes while wearing winter scarves.

pages.title: Hello Kitty and Mimmy Exchange Christmas Gifts Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty and Mimmy swap presents on a round rug beside a Christmas tree with garlands and a fireplace lined with stockings.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Hangs a Stocking by the Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty hangs a Christmas stocking in this printable coloring page, beside a brick fireplace with burning logs and a garland strung with round ornaments.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Ice Skates on Christmas Day Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Hello Kitty ice skating on one foot in her winter coat and scarf, with two decorated Christmas trees behind her.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Sleds Down a Snowy Hill at Christmas Coloring Page
pages.description: With her scarf trailing behind, Hello Kitty grips the sled rope on this printable coloring page as she slides past a tree hung with ornaments.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Writes a Letter to Santa Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty writes a letter to Santa with a pencil at her round table beside an envelope and a striped candy cane.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Sips Hot Cocoa on Christmas Eve Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty warms her paws around a steaming mug on this printable coloring page, with marshmallows in her Christmas Eve cocoa and a star atop the tree.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Paints a Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hello Kitty painting stars on a large round Christmas ornament, with a palette and an open paint pot on the table.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Dresses Up as a Christmas Elf Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty stands in a Christmas elf costume on this printable coloring page, wearing a bell-tipped hat, a pointed collar, and curled shoes.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Shows Off Her Christmas Sweater Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hello Kitty raising her paws to display a Christmas sweater patterned with rows of snowflakes and a large evergreen topped by a star.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Makes a Snow Angel on Christmas Day Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty spreads her arms to make a snow angel on this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat beneath an evergreen branch with a hanging ornament.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Waves Inside a Christmas Snow Globe Coloring Page
pages.description: Inside the snow globe on this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty waves beside a little Christmas tree, with snowflakes overhead and holly decorating the base.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Visits Santa's Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty visits Santa's workshop in this printable coloring page, standing behind a toy train with a teddy bear and rocking horse on the shelf behind her.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Leaves Milk and Cookies for Santa Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Hello Kitty sets out star-shaped cookies and a glass of milk near a fireplace with a Christmas stocking.
